# rsync wrapper using cp for basic functionality
# Handles: rsync -av --delete source dest

args=("$@")
source=""

# Parse simple rsync -av --delete source dest pattern
for ((i=0; i<${#args[@]}; i++)); do
    case "${args[$i]}" in
        -av|--archive|-a|--archive*)
            ;;
        --delete)
            ;;
        -*)
            ;;
        *)
            if [ -z "$source" ]; then
                source="${args[$i]}"
            elif [ -z "$dest" ]; then
                dest="${args[$i]}"
            fi
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -n "$source" ] && [ -n "$dest" ]; then
    # Check if --delete is in args
    if [[ " ${args[@]} " =~ " --delete " ]]; then
        # Remove destination directory contents first
        rm -rf "$dest"/*
    fi
    # Copy with archive mode
    cp -a "$source/"* "$dest/" 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$source" "$dest"
fi

            ;;
        --delete)
            ;;
        -*)

#!/bin/bash
# rsync wrapper using cp for basic functionality
# Handles: rsync -av --delete source dest

args=("$@")
source=""
dest=""

# Parse simple rsync -av --delete source dest pattern
for ((i=0; i<${#args[@]}; i++)); do
    case "${args[$i]}" in
        -av|--archive|-a|--archive*)
            ;;
        --delete)
            ;;
        -*)
            ;;
        *)
            if [ -z "$source" ]; then
                source="${args[$i]}"
            elif [ -z "$dest" ]; then
                dest="${args[$i]}"
            fi
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -n "$source" ] && [ -n "$dest" ]; then
    # Check if --delete is in args
    if [[ " ${args[@]} " =~ " --delete " ]]; then
        # Remove destination directory contents first
        rm -rf "$dest"/*
    fi
    # Copy with archive mode
    cp -a "$source/"* "$dest/" 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$source" "$dest"
fi
